title: R1 Neo: LEDs
description: Validate LED control on R1 Neo. Ensure led0 alias exists and lichen_hal_led_get() returns correct gpio_dt_spec. Test LED on/off/blink.
close_reason: Already validated: led0 alias exists in DTS (line 52), lichen_hal_led_get() correctly uses GPIO_DT_SPEC_GET(DT_ALIAS(led0), gpios), CONFIG_LICHEN_HAS_LEDS=y in config, and BUILD_ASSERT validates config at compile time. Hardware on/off/blink testing requires physical R1 Neo.
